subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, retention & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jared Lee <jared.lee@acme-corp.com>, Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, retention & next steps

Hi Jared / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side to make sure we captured the pain, goals, and immediate asks so we can keep momentum. Please reply if I missed anything.

1) Key pain points you shared
- Need enterprise-grade audit logs and retention controls for regulatory customers (financial data flows through product).
- SOC 2 attestation required for any vendor with production data access.
- DPA and clear subprocessor list required; procurement needs an editable DPA draft.
- Pen test evidence: you’d like the summary report and any remediation timelines.

2) Goals / success criteria
- SOC 2 Type II attestation on file before pilot (target: by end of Q1).
- Audit logs available with 1-year retention and exportable schema for ingestion into ACME SIEM.
- DPA executed and legal review complete prior to production go-live.

3) What we can provide immediately (next 48–72h)
- Redwood SOC 2 summary (what’s in scope + controls mapping). [Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf]
- Short pen-test summary and remediation status. [Attachment: PenTest_Report_Summary.pdf]
- Audit logs schema and sample CSV export. [Attachment: Audit_Logs_Schema.csv]
- Editable DPA draft for procurement to review. [Attachment: DPA_Draft_ACME.docx]

4) Action items / owners
- Redwood: Send artifacts listed above (Marissa) — ETA: 24–48 hours.
- Redwood: Schedule follow-up call with security/engineering to walk logs/export format (Rishi + Vivek) — propose Mon 2/16 or Tue 2/17 (Jared/Sarah availability?).
- ACME: Share procurement timelines and any redlines to the DPA — Owner: procurement@acme-corp.com — ETA: EOM Feb.

5) Risks / blockers
- If SOC 2 attestation is a hard stop for your legal team, please flag any additional requirements today so we can prioritize.

I’ve attached the artifacts mentioned above in this thread. Looking forward to the next steps.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf]

From: Jared Lee <jared.lee@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, retention & next steps

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifying items: 

- SOC 2: Do you have the full Type II report available under NDA, or only a summary? Our security team will likely ask for the full report under an NDA.
- Audit logs: sample CSV looks fine from what we saw on the call. Can you confirm timezone info and whether logs include request/response payload hashes (we need to ensure no PHI is present)?
- Pen test: can you confirm when the last full pen test was run and whether any critical/high findings remain open?

We’re generally aligned on timelines — procurement will review the DPA once you send the editable doc. For the follow-up call, Mon 2/16 10:00am PT works for Sarah and me.

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Lee
Security Operations Manager
ACME Corp
jared.lee@acme-corp.com
[Disclaimer: this email may contain confidential information]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jared Lee <jared.lee@acme-corp.com>, Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, retention & next steps

Hi Jared / Sarah / Procurement —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Answers inline and attached artifacts included: 

- SOC 2: We’ve attached the Redwood SOC 2 summary today (Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf). We can share the full Type II report under a mutual NDA / standard vendor NDA. If you want the full report, please send your NDA or we can route via our legal team — typical turnaround 24–48 hours after NDA is in place.
  - Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf

- Audit logs: Attached is Audit_Logs_Schema.csv showing column names, sample rows, and timestamp format (ISO-8601, UTC). We include request_id, request_path, truncated_request_hash, response_status, user_id (pseudonymized), and processing_node. Payloads are never included in full in the logs by default — only hashes/truncated digests. If you require custom fields (e.g., additional metadata), we can add those via config.
  - Attachment: Audit_Logs_Schema.csv

- Pen test: Latest full pen test completed Nov 2025. The summary report is attached (PenTest_Report_Summary.pdf). No critical findings remain open; 2 high findings were remediated in Dec 2025 and verified in our follow-up assessment. Full report available under NDA.
  - Attachment: PenTest_Report_Summary.pdf

- DPA: Editable draft attached for procurement review. We’ve highlighted common areas customers request edits on (data retention, subprocessors, incident notification timelines).
  - Attachment: DPA_Draft_ACME.docx

Next steps (confirmed):
- Redwood: Share full SOC2 and pen test on NDA — Marissa (I’ll coordinate legal) — ETA: 24–48h after NDA
- Redwood: Rishi + Vivek to do technical deep-dive on logs and retention Mon 2/16 10:00am PT (calendar invite to follow)
- ACME: Procurement to review DPA and share any redlines — procurement@acme-corp.com — aim to complete by end of Feb

I’ve attached the artifacts in this email for procurement/security to begin review. If procurement wants an editable Google Doc instead, we can push it to a shared Drive link.

Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
[Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, Audit_Logs_Schema.csv, PenTest_Report_Summary.pdf, DPA_Draft_ACME.docx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, retention & next steps

Thanks for the thread and the artifacts, Marissa. A couple internal notes: 

- Approved to share the full SOC2/pen-test under our standard mutual NDA — Marissa, loop Legal and I if ACME provides an NDA; otherwise use the template link in the shared drive.
- Rishi/Vivek: please prepare a ~30-min deep dive deck for Mon 2/16 focused on the log export format, retention controls, and configuration options for pseudonymization and key management.
- Sales ops: be prepared to capture procurement timelines and any discount request; keep deal stage updated in HubSpot (link in thread).

Laura
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com
[Internal only note: if ACME requests on-prem or VPC, we need to engage Solutions Eng early.]
